# freecenter_backup (Resource)

A backup of a virtual machine, taken when the resource is created: a consolidated copy of its disks and configuration in the freecenter-backups folder of a datastore. A running VM is backed up through a temporary snapshot. Destroying the resource deletes the backup. For recurring backups use freecenter_schedule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datastore` (String) Datastore of the VM's host the backup is written to.
- `vm_id` (String) The virtual machine to back up (freecenter_vm id).

### Optional

- `target_datastore` (String) Datastore on target_host_id.
- `target_host_id` (String) Move the backup to this other host (optional).
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values: changing any of them takes a new backup (and deletes this one).

### Read-Only

- `backup_datastore` (String) Datastore that holds the backup.
- `created` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `host_id` (String) Host that holds the backup.
- `id` (String) <host_id>/<datastore>/<vm_name>/<stamp>: usable as restore_from of freecenter_vm.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of the backup.
- `stamp` (String) Time stamp of the backup (YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS, UTC).
- `vm_name` (String) Name of the VM when it was backed up.
